title: Extraction and Identification of Volatile Organic Compounds Emitted by Fragrant Flowers of Three Tillandsia Species by HS-SPME/GC-MS
why: Tillandsia sense_chemical: the volatile compounds given off by the flowers of three fragrant Tillandsia species, sampled by headspace. The abstract start (OpenAlex, harvest run 4) says flower volatiles serve pollination, defence and communication with other organisms, so the text may report emission by living flowers as a signal; whether the flowers were attached to living plants or cut is not visible in the abstract start. The listing gives no author list and the paper was not opened.

title: Pregerminative treatments in Tillandsia ionantha seeds to obtain seedlings under in vitro culture
why: Tillandsia sense_light_nonvisual: a germination trial on Tillandsia ionantha seeds whose first factor is lighting condition (light against dark), the kind of response main logs as non-visual light sensing for other plants. The abstract start does not give the result for the light factor, so the text may report germination in light and in darkness. The same title is also listed as 10.32854/agrop.vi.2260 (AgEcon Search, 2025). The listing gives no author list and the paper was not opened.
